rows.name: Flags information page
steps: Look at pictures of flags and name each.
List the flags in singular and plural (वचन).
Write three sentences of information about one flag, using a pronoun.

levels.1: Flag facts are listed without singular or plural forms.
levels.2: Three sentences about a flag use correct plurals (वचन) and pronouns.
levels.3: A poem or paragraph on what the flag stands for is added.

steps: List three difficult words and find synonyms.
Hold a short conversation (वार्तालाप) using the words.

levels.2: Sentence uses a new difficult word correctly.
levels.3: Same word is used in a second sentence with a different meaning.

rows.name: Round things list
steps: Look at 'गोल-गोल संसार' picture story and name the round things.
Make a list (सूची-निर्माण) of round objects in the room.
Identify the shape of each object.
Share the list with the group.

levels.0: List of round objects is empty.
levels.2: List has at least five round objects with their plural forms (वचन).
levels.3: Objects are sorted by size or colour.

steps: Make a chart paper list of the story's rules, one on each line (चार्ट पेपर गतिविधि).

levels.1: One rule from the story is written, with no reason.
levels.2: Chart lists the story's rules, one on each line.
levels.3: Each rule on the chart has a reason with 'क्योंकि'.
